video_title: Kawhi Leonard Returns to the Toronto Raptors | Open Gym Presented by Bell

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on Kawhi Leonard's impact on the Toronto Raptors
quotes.excerpt: I think that he's going to bring a lot of experience, wisdom, and on-court presence.

text_blocks.speaker: Darko Rajaković
text_blocks.text: I think that he's going to bring a lot of experience, wisdom, and on-court presence that he's going to be able to help us to move the needle with our team into the right direction.

text_blocks.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
text_blocks.text: You guys were very aggressive last year. Playing against you guys and watching, it was fun. Like I said, I'm not here to take over anything. I want to help your vision, help Scottie, whatever. I just want to win. If it's Scottie's team, it's his team. I just want to do whatever it takes to help you guys win.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on his decision to return to Toronto
quotes.excerpt: The city took a liking to my family, I took a liking to the city.
quotes.quote: I'm not really championship chasing and trying to find the best team I could win. I didn't want to put on a thousand jerseys and, you know, the city took a liking to my family, I took a liking to the city. I really enjoyed it, my son was born here and he's been asking me forever when he's going to come back. Now he's back and he's able to see it rather than me telling him the great stories that happened.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković recalls being in the San Antonio draft room for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: The day you got drafted, I was with San Antonio in the draft room.
quotes.quote: I want to tell you a funny story. I was working with San Antonio. I was coaching in Europe and I was their international scout. So the day you got drafted, I was with San Antonio in the draft room. I was part of the trade. I was like seven people. There was Lindsey, RC, coach Pop, I was there with like a couple of scouts. And when we traded George Hill and we got your draft rights, I was there when you got drafted.

quotes.speaker: Allen Graves
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Graves on the opportunity to learn from Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Being able to be teammates with Kawhi Leonard is just insane.
quotes.quote: Being able to be teammates with Kawhi Leonard is just insane. He's, if not the greatest defender in the NBA, and just being able to learn from him and that's the biggest part of my game that I want to focus on is the defensive side of the ball and just being able to have that resource is going to be amazing.

quotes.speaker: Collin Murray-Boyles
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Murray-Boyles on Kawhi Leonard's attention to detail
quotes.excerpt: Even at his age, he's still one of the best players.
quotes.quote: Even at his age, he's still one of the best players. His attention to detail, I know it's sharp. I know the process to get to that level is born. So to see like how he attacks it, his mindset, and just learn how to, you know, be where he's at.
